purpose: A pending lower send copies the current array value into a used yield slot while by-reference foreach retains the acquired wrapper. After pending upper THROW and physical close, whole-wrapper replacement must keep the old array through the separate input owner and the new array through the mutable wrapper.

$child = reviewBufferedReferenceRootChild26(); $lower = reviewBufferedReferenceRootLower26(); $upper = reviewBufferedReferenceRootUpper26(); $outer = reviewBufferedReferenceRootOuter26();
